title: Quick Silky Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and kid-friendly Moroccan dish featuring a smooth, slightly spicy sauce and a crunchy green salsa.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
Add the chopped onion, green salsa, nuka-pickle, and chicken broth to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the yogurt and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
